def test_staged_recovery_policy_uses_one_repair(self):
        source = Path(helix.__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")

        self.assertIn(
            "if staged_repair >= 1:",
            source,
        )
        self.assertIn(
            "[CORE] staged recovery -> finish_file",
            source,
        )
        self.assertIn(
            'f"{staged_repair}/1: "',
            source,
        )
